messages:
jen: Quiet window starts in ~90m. We need a final pin decision for the engine + quant bundle. Can we lock traffic to engine@r245-qv3 but avoid thermal nodes?

nate: Canary telemetry looks mostly clean at 1%. No perf regressions overall, but saw a tail-latency spike ~200ms on two hosts for ~5m around 22:04.

leo: That spike lines up with the matmul kernel v5 path. One host OOM'd and evicted to fallback; ops recovered it. I'd prefer a conservative pin (no gpu-thermal tag).

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout initiated: engine@r245-qv3 -> 1% traffic. Track at https://deploys.redwood/internal/rollouts/5532109999 :eyes:

jen: Proposal: apply a routing pin for 90m to engine@r245-qv3 excluding fleet tag 'gpu-thermals'. If stable, escalate to 20% after 45m.

anya: +1. Add explicit rollback triggers: p95 latency >15% above baseline sustained for 10m OR error-rate >= 2x for 5m. Also watch GPU temp >85C on >3 hosts.

chris: I can apply the pin. Suggest TTL=3h so we don't forget. Command I'll run: 

```
deployctl pin --service=runtime --version=engine@r245-qv3 --ttl=3h --exclude-tag=gpu-thermal --note "night-quiet-window"
```

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Pin applied by chris at 5532109999. Pin id: pin-88c3. TTL=3h.

ops-bot: ops-bot: smoke checks running: gen-latency p50/p95 nominal, embed throughput 98-102% of baseline, no error spike.

nate: FYI one canary host still showing KV cache growth; I'm pushing a small eviction patch (evict older prefixes at 20k keys/shard) to that host now.

jen: If that patch doesn't stabilize within 15m we roll back. Who's oncall for a rollback action? @leo

leo: I can handle rollback. Plan: revert routing to engine@r244 and remove the pin. Rollback command ready: `deployctl rollback --service=runtime --to=engine@r244`

chris: :thumbsup: I'll draft the release notes blurb and post to #release-notes after we clear 45m. Draft link: https://docs.redwood/internal/release-notes/engine-r245-qv3

jen: OK monitoring window set for 45m. If p95 >+15% or errors x2, ping me @jen immediately and we'll abort.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary metrics snapshot (10m moving window): p95 +3%, errors +0% — no automated actions triggered.
